name: Leather Vest
desc: Light, quiet, and no help at all against a flame.

name: Padded Coat
desc: Quilted against the cold. Bulky through a doorway.

name: Leather Garb
desc: Worn soft by the road. It hides nothing and it slows nothing.

name: Fur Mantle
desc: A whole pelt. Frost and spark slide off it; a spark of the other kind does not.

name: Tarred Jerkin
desc: Pitch keeps the lightning out. It burns, and it cracks in the cold.

name: Pilgrim's Robe
desc: Blessed at every shrine on the road down. No blessing stops a blade.

name: Thief's Cloak
desc: Dark wool with too many pockets. Light on the feet, thin against a blade.

name: Monk's Wraps
desc: Bands of linen, wound tight for the fist. The dark finds the gaps.

name: Apprentice Robe
desc: Singed at the hem, as they all are. The lessons stuck.

name: Chain Mail
desc: Turns a blade, and draws lightning like a hooked rug.

name: Salt-Tanned Hide
desc: Cured hard in brine. Whatever crawls does not like it.

name: Silver Armour
desc: Polished to throw back whatever is thrown at it.

name: Scale Hauberk
desc: Overlapping plates on a leather backing. Heavy in all the usual places.

name: Bronze Cuirass
desc: Turns an edge and shrugs off heat. Rings like a bell when the sky strikes.

name: Wyrmhide Jacket
desc: A young drake's skin, good in the fire and the cold. It never learned the storm.

name: Grave Shroud
desc: Taken off someone who did not need it. The dark and the cold know it as theirs.

name: Berserker Hide
desc: A bear's pelt, worn head and all. You think less and hit harder.

name: Sage's Vestment
desc: Embroidered with every word the order kept. None of them stop a sword.

name: Marsh Leathers
desc: Oiled for the fens. Cold and venom run off it; the storm runs in.

name: Plate Armour
desc: Everything a smith knows, all at once, all of it heavy.

name: Warded Surcoat
desc: Stitched through with something that objects to being looked at.

name: Gold Armour
desc: Soft, heavy, and it makes you look worth robbing.

name: Mythril Chain
desc: The only mail down here that costs you nothing to wear.

name: Obsidian Plate
desc: Volcanic glass, edge-proof and fire-born. Cold shatters it; lightning finds the seams.

name: Stormglass Mail
desc: Fused where lightning struck sand. It drinks the storm and the frost, and melts.

name: Templar's Hauberk
desc: Consecrated mail. Steel and the light both glance off; the dark has its measure.

name: Duellist's Coat
desc: Cut for the lunge. It has seen more first blood than last.

name: Warlock's Robe
desc: Heavy with sigils, and the arms are too long for anything but casting.

name: Spiked Plate
desc: Every edge of it is a point. A shoulder in this is an attack.

name: Gargoyle Scale
desc: Prised off something that was part of a wall. Still wants to be one.

name: Drakescale Cuirass
desc: It has already survived worse than anything down here.

name: Platinum Armour
desc: No trick to it and no hole in it. Only the number.

name: Diamond Armour
desc: Set with stone across the chest. It cracks at a temperature you will meet.

name: Saint's Raiment
desc: Cloth, and it has outlasted every plate in this tier.

name: Abyssal Carapace
desc: Grown, not forged, somewhere under the last floor. It hates the light and the storm.

name: Seraph's Mail
desc: Feather-light and bright. Storm, frost and the light all pass it by; the dark does not.

name: Dragonbone Plate
desc: Cut from the dragons themselves: fire, frost and storm. Nothing holy or unholy in it.

name: Mirrorplate
desc: Polished until it shows you everything. Holy and unholy both turn on it; steel does not.

name: Dragonlord Mail
desc: Red scale on black steel, cut to the king's own measure. It runs hot, and the cold bites it.

name: Shadow Weave
desc: Spun from the dark between torches. A lamp shows it for what it is.
